overall_reason: A share dialog ('Share document / Launch brief / Anyone with the link / Can view / Copy link') rendered entirely in pale grey, so its one action reads as disabled.

score.reason: T-BOLD-MOVE fails: no element is louder than the rest, and the 'Copy link' button reads as disabled; T-ONE-SENTENCE passes on the content.

findings.title: Spend boldness in one place
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the title, labels and the 'Copy link' button are all low-contrast grey on a grey card on a grey stage; the button's white text sits on a pale grey fill.
findings.before: Every element at the same washed-out weight.
findings.after: Give 'Copy link' a solid fill with full-contrast text and set the title in full ink.
findings.why: With nothing louder than the rest, the dialog's single action looks unavailable.

strengths: The content is the right minimum for sharing: document name, access, permission and one action.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
Capture timing: the dialog may have been caught mid fade-in; manifest.json prep is empty and network is direct, so it was judged as rendered.
